{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

valid_ages = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]

mean_age = valid_ages['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Total converted customers: {len(converted_customers)}")
